Method of Attack: Exploiting BlueKeep (CVE-2019-0708) unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in Remote Desktop Services
Downloading and executing obfuscated PowerShell scripts
Attack Vector: Internet-facing Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) services found via port scans
Indicators of Compromise: Command-and-control (C2) infrastructure used in September coin mining campaign and November BlueKeep attacks
IP addresses connected by coin miners in earlier campaigns
PowerShell scripts executed on compromised systems
